description: A ring of chalk scuffed into the concrete around the back-room drain: the Sump's whole reason for being. By day it is just a stain you step over on your way to the bench. By night two lines of regulars toe the chalk and this becomes an arena the width of a back room, which is to say: no room at all to dodge, which is the point. The drain in the middle takes the sweat, the spilled beer, and occasionally the loser. Faded numbers are painted at the edges where a scoreboard used to hang.
name: the slag pit
